title: Universality and Dynamical Inequivalence in Isospectral Non-Hermitian Anderson Transitions
summary: The Hatano Nelson paradigm establishes that extensive bulk nonreciprocity can destabilize Anderson localization via an imaginary gauge flux. Here, we demonstrate that extensive nonreciprocity is not a necessary ingredient: a single non-Hermitian boundary bond in a disordered one-dimensional ring suffices to drive the localization-delocalization transition. More generally, we construct an exactly isospectral family of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that continuously interpolates between the uniform Hatano Nelson model and the single-bond limit.
